# Shift AI Tech

> Shift AI is a technology studio. We turn ambitious briefs into working AI products, automation, and digital products.

Shift AI Tech (legal: Shift AI Technology Ltd, Companies House 17159725) is a technology studio based in Southminster, Essex, United Kingdom. We build bespoke AI models, agents, automation, and digital products around the business in front of us.

Disambiguation: not Shift Technology (insurance AI at shift-technology.com), not Shift AI at shiftai.co.uk (automotive dealer tools), not SHIFT AI LTD (Newcastle, 17222733), and not other unrelated "Shift AI" brands. Our domain is exclusively https://shiftaitech.com.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://shiftaitech.com/): The AI Shape-Shifters. Studio, products, team, and how to start a brief.
- [Websites](https://shiftaitech.com/websites): Brochure websites from £500, AED 2,500, or $650. Design, build, host, and SEO foundations. Extra development from £50/hr, AED 250/hr, or $65/hr. eCommerce and AI modules start with a free consultation, then scoped pricing. Start at partnerships@shiftaitech.com.
- [Our Story](https://shiftaitech.com/our-story): How we funded neural models for Bitcoin prediction and cut rebuild cost 82% with AI tooling
- [Partners](https://shiftaitech.com/partners): Specialist partners (RAMDVG, AP Creative Co) and infrastructure programmes (AWS Activate, NVIDIA Inception)
- [Refer and Earn](https://shiftaitech.com/refer): Refer a business to Shift and earn 10% of the project price plus 10% of every monthly fee, paid within 7 days of the client paying.
- [Team](https://shiftaitech.com/team): Jack Rockell (CTO), Darren Bishop (Head of Operations), Dan Kent (Developer).
- [Onboarding](https://shiftaitech.com/onboarding): Start a project with Shift AI Tech
- [The AI Value Shift](https://shiftaitech.com/research/research-paper-3): Research note on measurable AI business impact, drawn from BCG, McKinsey, Deloitte, and PwC

## Services

- Custom AI: models, agents, and RAG on your data
- Product builds: concept to live deployment
- Automation: replace slow manual workflows
- Strategy: scoped, priced AI opportunities before you commit
- Websites: bespoke design/build/host with SEO foundations
